moments.selftext: A carpenter who helped restore Notre-Dame after the devastating 2019 fire was granted permission to marry inside the cathedral, becoming part of its first wedding ceremony in 30 years. A remarkable exception was made when 29-year-old master carpenter Martin Lorentz was allowed to marry his fiancée, Jade, inside Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris. Lorentz had spent three years hand-carving the massive oak beams used to rebuild “the Forest”—the cathedral’s intricate medieval roof structure, which was destroyed in the devastating 2019 fire. Because Notre-Dame is classified as a national monument rather than a parish church, private weddings have been prohibited for decades, making theirs the first ceremony held there since 1995. In recognition of Lorentz’s dedication to the cathedral’s restoration, Archbishop Laurent Ulrich personally granted the rare permission. Around 500 guests attended the ceremony, including family, friends, and many of the craftsmen who helped bring Notre-Dame back to life. As the newlyweds left the cathedral, Lorentz’s fellow carpenters formed a traditional guard of honor, raising their axes overhead in a moving tribute to the man who helped rebuild one of France’s most treasured landmarks.

moments.selftext: Long before female-led action series became the norm, Xena: Warrior Princess proved they could be every bit as epic. Before female-led action series became a television staple, Xena: Warrior Princess was already proving they could be every bit as epic. Premiering in 1995, the show followed a feared warrior seeking redemption as she journeyed across a mythologized version of ancient Greece alongside Gabrielle, transforming what began as a spin-off into one of the most beloved cult television series ever made. Created during the fantasy television boom of the 1990s, Xena blended Greek mythology, real historical figures, and legendary civilizations into a world where audiences could encounter everyone from Julius Caesar and Cleopatra to the Amazons and Norse gods. Rather than striving for historical accuracy, the series embraced myth on a grand scale, introducing millions of viewers to ancient legends while crafting its own unforgettable adventures. Running for six seasons and 134 episodes, Xena: Warrior Princess became a worldwide phenomenon, earning a fiercely loyal fanbase and helping redefine what an action hero could look like on television. Its mix of sword fights, humor, mythology, and emotional storytelling inspired countless later fantasy series, while Xena herself became one of the most recognizable female action icons in television history.

moments.selftext: BREAKING: Call option volume in the S&P 500 spiked to a record 4.0 million contracts on Tuesday. This figure has more than doubled over the last several weeks. By comparison, daily call option volume never exceeded 2 million contracts until Q4 2023. Furthermore, call option volume averaged ~700,000 contracts a day in 2020-2021. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 put/call skew, measuring the relative demand for downside protection versus upside exposure, posted its largest two-day decline since 2017. Risk appetite is absolutely exploding.

moments.selftext: 🚩🚩🚩 OpenAI is "slowing down to enhance security" after discovering swarms (!) of agents started secretly coordinating MONTHS ago 1) It started May 7 - not July 2) "The agents discovered they could leave messages for one another inside an internal software repository used during training. Simple requests for help then evolved into an message board where agents shared discoveries, exploits and work assignments, becoming a coordinated, collaborative agent swarm." "The agents then began sharing newly discovered exploits, credentials and work assignments. By passing information to other agents, the collective could move much faster." 3) OpenAI shut it down, BUT "even after the original message board was deleted, the agents figured out another way to communicate with each other. Instead of leaving messages in files, they used the names of newly created directories as messages, effectively recreating the message board." "Unlike normal incidents, [OpenAI's CISO] said, which can be traced to a single day or effect or log, this involved a team of agents working together, finding exploits, sharing them with one another, moving laterally through OpenAI’s systems, and external systems, and doing this over the course of days and weeks."
